name: Super Large Creature Critical Strike Table

notes.columns: Columns are the attacking weapon's enchantment class (Normal / Magic / Mithril / Holy Arms / Slaying).

rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax inclusive. Attacks vs super large creatures can exceed 100; bands run to 251+ and rolls above the top band clamp to it.

normal.text: You strike the terrible beast hard. Your weapon breaks in half.

magic.text: Your weapon is knocked from your hand. It will take 2 rounds to recover.

mithril.text: Your strike is powerful. You fumble the rest of the round.

holy.text: Your strike is powerful, but your grip was terrible. Roll a fumble for yourself.

slaying.text: The numbing recoil of your strike to foe's chest sends you stumbling back.

normal.text: A decoration pops off your weapon with impact to foe's side.

magic.text: Your weapon hits at a bad angle. Take a weapon strength check. Bum luck.

mithril.text: Your weapon lands uneven across foe's shoulder. Make a breakage check.

holy.text: Blow foe's arm. Ready for a better strike. You gain the initiative next round.

slaying.text: Strike lands at a bad angle. You check for weapon breakage.

normal.text: You are daunted by the beast's gaze and swing weakly.

magic.text: Your blow was deflected, but you gain the initiative next round.

mithril.text: Acceptable strike to foe's leg. You gain the initiative next round.

holy.text: Back strike. Weapon seems to damage by touch only.

slaying.text: Blow to back. You gain the initiative next round.

normal.text: This terrible creature's hide deflects the strongest blows.

magic.text: Glancing side blow. A spark of light reminds you your weapon is magical.

mithril.text: Glancing blow smears mithril like chalk across beast's hide.

holy.text: Your strike is solid and flat, but foe is not slowed at all.

slaying.text: Sparks fly from your weapon as it embraces your foe.

normal.text: Solid strike to foe's side with your common weapon fails to penetrate.

magic.text: Foe is unbalanced. You gain the initiative next round.

mithril.text: Solid, but nowhere near a vital spot. Bruise foe's calf muscle.

holy.text: You strike the fell titan in the chest. He yells back at you.

slaying.text: Boom! Solid without question. Try a vital spot next time.

normal.text: Your strike was more of a last minute parry to avoid the beast's.

magic.text: You deal out a sharp and hard leg strike. Foe steps back to look at his leg.

mithril.text: Strike lands on foe's horn. The vibration has some effect.

holy.text: You step under his assault and strike him hard in the abdomen.

slaying.text: Rip sinew, hair, horn and scale with a glancing blow to side.

normal.text: Two light and quick shots to foe's forearm provide a modest result.

magic.text: Blow to foe's back. Foe's hide is tough there. You need more strength.

mithril.text: Your strike thumps foe on his nose. He is insulted, but not wounded badly.

holy.text: The vile beast leans forward. You strike at his snout in frantic response.

slaying.text: Unexpected weak spot found with your strike to foe's side.

normal.text: Strike foe's neck with the flat of your weapon during a moment of opportunity.

magic.text: You step under foe's lunge and use the force against him. Strike to under belly. He feels the pain instantly.

mithril.text: Shin strike. Skin is torn open and bone is bruised. This one hurts. You have initiative.

holy.text: Your blow lands against foe's shoulder. You are pleased with the effect. Blood pours from the wound.

slaying.text: Your weapon seems to dig into foe's chest and devour his heart. Foe dies instantly. You are covered with blood.

normal.text: Solid strike on foe's leg. You move quickly away to avoid the retaliation.

magic.text: Blow to thigh leaves a bad bruise. Your weapon cracks and bends. It will break after one more strike.

mithril.text: Hammering foe's thigh gets you some respect. You have the initiative.

holy.text: Hard blow to foe's thigh. He stumbles, but does not fall. You have the initiative next round.

slaying.text: Flat strike to foe's upper body. Heavy blow breaks some bones. Foe's guard is down.

normal.text: Solid strike to foe's head just bounces off.

magic.text: Minor forearm wound. The beast used its forearm for defense. Foe soaks up the damage.

mithril.text: Blow to foe's upper arm. This strike had few vices, but it was weak. Get it together.

holy.text: Catch foe in his exposed leg. You come down hard on it. He will have a bruise. It slows him. You have the initiative.

slaying.text: Hard glancing strike crosses foe's shoulder and chest. Shoulder is slashed and chest is bruised.

normal.text: Violent strike to foe's forearm. Foe is bruised. Your weapon must make a breakage check.

magic.text: Blow to foe's arm joint lands poorly. Foe will have a bruise. You think that you know what went wrong.

mithril.text: Your strike hit no vitals, but you can hear the ribs in foe's side crackle. Foe fights on in some pain.

holy.text: To make this strike land well, you almost climb onto foe. You deal out a brutal strike to his neck and leap back.

slaying.text: Just when your swing looked to be failing your weapon took control and crashed into foe's thigh.

normal.text: Well placed and hard. Try a vital spot next time.

magic.text: Blow is placed solidly against foe's side. The thick hide there protects him well.

mithril.text: Slash at foe's neck fails to land very hard. You have the initiative for 2 rounds.

holy.text: You have an uncomfortable opportunity to strike foe in his mouth. If foe has a breath weapon, he may not use it.

slaying.text: Your master strike lands against foe's neck. Doom is in his face. He drops and dies in 3 rounds.

normal.text: Blow severs vein and artery in foe's upper leg. He drops and dies after 12 inactive rounds. Awesome!

magic.text: You are a mighty warrior. Your strike hits foe's neck and breaks it. Bones are crushed and the spine is broken. Foe drops in 1 round and dies.

mithril.text: Blow to lower skull area. Foe dies instantly. He stumbles on for 1 round, until he realizes this.

holy.text: Weapon bites into foe's skull. He just comes apart. He dies in 6 rounds. Your weapon is stuck. Foe rolls over and takes your weapon out of reach.

slaying.text: Your weapon plunges into foe's chest making the nature of its forging certain. He dies a terrible and swift death. Take 12 rounds to reclaim your weapon.

normal.text: You step into the right spot and rip open foe's side. Your blow shatters some ribs.

magic.text: A little bird shows you the flaw in foe's armor. Your strike plunges into this vulnerable spot killing foe instantly.

mithril.text: Crush the bones in foe's neck with a mighty blow. Foe drops and dies in 1 round.

holy.text: Strike through foe's heart kills him instantly. You are too close. He pins you under him as he dies.

slaying.text: Foe's eye is in reach and you ram your weapon home. Foe dies after 3 rounds of inactivity. You have half the round left.

normal.text: Glancing strike to foe's abdomen loses much of the impact on foe's hide.

magic.text: Wound foe along his side with an excellent strike. Foe leaps back away from your weapon.

mithril.text: Graceful assault knocks down foe's defenses. He just cannot get his guard up.

holy.text: Brutal strike to foe's forearm. He reels from your presence. You are his bane.

slaying.text: Strike to foe's leg severs a vein and tears muscles. Foe flails around for 6 rounds before he dies.

normal.text: Your weapon wounds deep and cuts muscles and tendons. Foe's wound bleeds heavily.

magic.text: You pop foe on his head with some useful results. Foe is confused just long enough for a blow.

mithril.text: Incredible strike across foe's calf trips him to the ground. The bigger they are….

holy.text: Vicious blow to forehead sends foe to the ground. If he falls on stone, he is in a coma.

slaying.text: Awesome blow to foe's neck. His neck and back are broken. Foe drops and suffocates in 12 rounds.

normal.text: Foe presents a weak spot and you strike. Blow lands at the base of the neck. Tendons are damaged.

magic.text: Solid shot to foe's chest. Foe is down. You take an 'A' Unbalancing Critical result, because you are so close.

mithril.text: Brutal strike to foe's side. You rip him open and he is hating life. His blood gets all over you.

holy.text: Strike to foe's abdomen. Foe has the biggest bruise you have ever seen.

slaying.text: Clean strike to foe's eye kills him in one round. He fights on for 1 round before he realizes he is dead.

normal.text: When your strike lands on foe's back, bones crackle and pop. Internal damage is certain.

magic.text: Rip open foe's abdomen. Blood covers you. This cruel wound will not be healed easily.

mithril.text: Vicious blow to foe's leg. You can hear the mithril in your weapon talking, as you rip foe open.

holy.text: You duck around foe's side and catch him in the ear. Blow collapses skull. Foe dies of massive brain damage in 3 rounds.

slaying.text: Foe steps right into your swing. You tear open foe's abdomen and drop him in a heap. You are entangled in his fall. Foe dies in 4 rounds from shock.

normal.text: Foe lowers his eyes within your reach and you strike with great skill and fury. He is blinded.

magic.text: You leap up and slam foe in the eye. He does not realize he is dead yet. Next round he will. Your weapon is stuck for a round.

mithril.text: Awe inspiring strike drives bone through both lungs. Foe realizes his doom before falling into a coma. He dies in 18 rounds.

holy.text: Your mighty blow is the stuff epics are made of. Foe's spine is broken. He dies in 2 rounds.

slaying.text: Strike to side kills foe after a chain reaction of bones shatter. You are covered with blood.
